sources.role: Windows PC-98 emulator configuration, BIOS, disk and state behavior

paths.path: np21w.ini beside np21w.exe (the official Windows distribution uses INI configuration)
paths.naming: INI sections include [NekoProject21]; controller/key assignments are configured through the emulator's keyboard/joypad settings, with no stable serialized controller grammar documented

paths.path: np21w.ini and the keyboard/joypad configuration UI
paths.naming: Host keyboard keys and configured joypad buttons; no canonical portable binding syntax is documented

paths.path: Saved to the emulated PC-98 disk image or host files selected by the guest OS
paths.naming: Guest/application-defined files inside FDD/HDD images; no universal emulator sidecar save extension

paths.path: Same directory as np21w.ini when STATSAVE=true
paths.naming: State files use the np21/np21nt state naming generated by the program; exact filename is release/config dependent and not standardized in the public help

paths.path: ROM files beside the emulator/selected PC-98 ROM directory
paths.naming: BIOS.ROM and SOUND.ROM are named in the official download/help pages; ITF.ROM is explicitly not used; IDE/SCSI BIOS can be real optional ROMs. No canonical checksums are published

evidence: source:SimK98/np21w@5a8c1f3eda94c7089920227204dcb1682cdfb906 (no external cryptographic-key file identified in the pinned source)

linux.reason: Neko Project 21/W is distributed and documented as a Windows executable; no native Linux build is provided by the upstream project.

linux-flatpak.reason: No upstream Flatpak manifest or package is published.

macos.reason: The upstream project publishes Windows binaries and documentation only; no macOS build is provided.
